text:
Maya: Friday night retro rumble in the mezz? projector + CRT, couch, pizza? 7pm start. low-key LAN vibes :video_game: :pizza:
Tom: absolutely. i can lug the CRT up the stairs if someone helps 😅
Aisha: I'll bring my PS2 w/ Mario Kart + a couple controllers. also down for some Smash on the Switch afterwards.
Riley: can we also slot a Steam co-op block? i can host Helldivers and Left 4 Dead backups if people want PC.
Devon: ethernet please. wifi + CRT = lag nightmares. i have a 24-port switch and a couple cables.
Sam: i have power strips and a surge protector. also can bribe people with homemade cookies :cookie:
Maya: perfect — sounds like we have console + PC. can folks react \":thumbsup:\" for yes, :pizza: if they'd like pizza, and :beer: if they want drinks? will order accordingly.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Aisha: :thumbsup: + :pizza:
Riley: :thumbsup: + prefer beer but soda ok :beer:
Devon: :thumbsup: i'll bring cables and a foam dolly for the CRT. not enough hands to carry it alone.
Sam: :thumbsup: + :pizza: (veggie option please)
Maya: ok tally so far: 5 yes, 3 pizza, 2 drinks. i'll create a quick signup and calendar event.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Mezz Retro Rumble" — Fri 19:00-23:00 — https://calendar.example.com/event/1995012345
Riley: can someone grab an HDMI→SCART adapter for the projector? i only have HDMI outputs.
Tom: i have one but it's busted — i'll see if the office spare box has a good one tonight.
Aisha: also need extra controllers for PS2 — if someone has wired pads, pls bring.
Devon: bring a roll of gaffer tape for loose cables and a label marker for controllers. trust me on this.
Maya: note for newbies: mezzanine has limited seating; bring beanbag or blanket if you want floor space.
Sam: heads up — parking is weird after 6pm on Friday; consider carpool or metro.
Tom: ETA for CRT move: 6:45pm. who can help carry?
Aisha: i'll help, plus two volunteers from my team said they'd show up earlier.
Riley: i'll be there by 6:30 to set up PC network and test Helldivers lobby.
Devon: i'll bring the switch and cables at 6:15, can pre-wire the router.
Maya: thanks all — i'll finalize pizza order tomorrow based on reactions and post the event link again. if anyone wants to add a game, DM me. :sparkles:
